name: craig
description: A local Claude Code mod that keeps a provider's tone policy out of your private draft.

scripts.build: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package craig-node --platform --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts --release && cargo build --release -p craig-cli -p craig-review --features craig-review/judge
scripts.build:debug: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package craig-node --platform --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run types:fetch && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.plugin.json
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/plugin.json
scripts.profile:memory: cargo build --profile profiling -p craig-cli && node --heap-prof scripts/profile.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run models:verify && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm run check && npm test && npm run validate && npm run test:plugin
scripts.policy:compare:profiling: cargo run --profile profiling -p craig-review --features judge -- policy-compare
scripts.build:inference:accelerate: cargo build --profile profiling -p craig --examples --features accelerate --target-dir target/accelerate
scripts.build:inference:metal: cargo build --profile profiling -p craig --examples --features metal --target-dir target/metal
scripts.build:inference:ffi:accelerate: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package craig-node --features craig/accelerate --profile profiling --target-dir target/accelerate --output-dir .cache/native-accelerate --platform --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts
scripts.build:inference:coreml: cargo build --profile profiling -p craig --examples --features coreml --target-dir target/coreml
scripts.build:inference:ffi:metal: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package craig-node --features craig/metal --profile profiling --target-dir target/metal --output-dir .cache/native-metal --platform --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts
scripts.build:inference:ffi:coreml: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package craig-node --features craig/coreml --profile profiling --target-dir target/coreml --output-dir .cache/native-coreml --platform --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts
scripts.build:decisions: cargo build --profile profiling -p craig-lab --bin decision && cargo build --profile profiling -p craig --example inference
scripts.build:decisions:debug: cargo build -p craig-lab --bin decision && cargo build -p craig --example inference
scripts.build:decisions:release: cargo build --release -p craig-lab --bin decision && cargo build --release -p craig --example inference
scripts.test:decisions: cargo test -p craig decision::tests && cargo test -p craig-lab --bin decision && node --test tests/benchmark.spec.mjs tests/decision.spec.mjs
scripts.profile:decisions:memory: cargo build --profile profiling -p craig --example inference_memory && node scripts/benchmark-inference.mjs --runner target/profiling/examples/inference_memory --detector crf --target-ms 500 --samples 1 --warmup 0 --fixtures-file tests/fixtures/decision-performance.json
